messages:
peter: FYI - seeing CRC counter increments on /dev/nvme0n1 across 3 nodes in us-central1. Two GPU pods failed attach with 'device read error'.

natalie: ugh, when did this start?

peter: started ~09:12 UTC during the nightly janitor window. I pulled the SMART log: 

peter: ```
$ nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1
critical_warning: 0
media_errors: 24
crc_errors: 12
temperature: 44 C
```

anjali: 24 media_errors is concerning. Are these nodes sticky to a cohort? which fleet slice?

peter: cohort b-ephemeral-005/006/014 (preemptible G4). All three show the same CRC bump pattern after background scrub cycles.

storage-bot: created ticket STOR-9241: "b-ephemeral CRC surge during janitor scrubs" (https://redwood/issue/STOR-9241) — scheduled scrub flagged.

natalie: can we throttle janitor/scrub concurrency on that cohort? sounds like the cleaner is colliding with hotstripe IO and exposing latent media/read-window faults. :thinking_face:

peter: proposal: mute janitor on b-ephemeral-* for 6h, drop scrub concurrency from 32 -> 4, and enable attach fallback to spare-nvme pool for GPU allocs.

anjali: +1. Also we should cordon the three nodes and run inline `nvme fw-log` and a read-only pass to confirm no remapped LBAs. I'll take maintenance windows.

peter: applying throttle now: `/deployments/janitor --cohort b-ephemeral --concurrency 4 --mute-duration 6h` (rolled as patch-202103).

ops-oncall: noted. Observing attach success rate improving; CRC increments slowed to 0->1 per hour instead of 4->6. Will keep an eye on errors/sec metrics. :eyes:

natalie: cost note — fallback to spare pool increases cross-pool evictions slightly; product impact <1% but keep finance in loop if we extend fallback.

peter: creating short incident blurb for #incidents and a follow-up action item to schedule firmware checks for the affected serials. Leaving a PM for a postmortem draft.

anjali: thanks — I'll queue the hardware maintenance and attach logs to STOR-9241. If CRCs stop after throttling we'll close as "janitor collision exposed latent media errors".
